title: 完整人工智能培训课程仓库
summary: 该仓库包含Fernando Amaral教授的完整人工智能培训课程，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、大语言模型、生成式AI、NLP、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法、模糊逻辑等，提供理论与实践结合的学习资源。
summary_en: Repository for the Complete Artificial Intelligence Training by Prof. Fernando Amaral, covering ML, DL, LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, Agents, Computer Vision, Anomaly Detection, Genetic Algorithms, Fuzzy Logic, with theory and hands-on Python practice.
